description: Hosted only. Alert your webhook (signed POST) after the daily refresh when a tracked rate for `gpu` crosses at or below max_hourly_usd, or a change of a watched kind (down/up/new; default down) lands at or below it. Only ELIGIBLE rates match (same contract as compare/estimate): every word of gpu must match the model; 'A100 80GB' or vram_gb=80 never matches a 40GB row; tiers (on-demand, community, marketplace, interruptible/spot, dedicated-monthly, reserved; default all but reserved) never matches another class; a row confirmed sold out never matches (in_stock='require' also skips unknown stock). region: code from availability.available_regions; a rate with no unexpired region evidence stays unresolved and never matches. Each event is delivered at most once per watch (dedupe on event_id). Pass api_key or an Authorization: Bearer header.
name: watch_price
